name: Round-topped gravestone
description: A weathered grey-brown sandstone headstone with a semicircular top, leaning back and to one side in a tuft of sod; a worn incised border, a cross in a roundel and a few rows of half-legible lettering on its face, moss on its crown and foot.

provenance.prompt: gravestone_round: a leaning round-topped headstone with a worn inscription and moss, about 0.6 × 0.2 × 1 m (plan 3, item 7).
